decision_target: Meaningful mechanical trap-tree construction, not production activation
trap_tree_method_result: Small graph construction works and two conditional tactical branches survive pair checks; selection reliability and coverage remain unvalidated
novelty_result: Prior-exposed benchmark: one exact known-reference prefix reconstructed; rook-sacrifice family also recurs at different timing. Exact novelty of other lines unknown; no novel-discovery claim.

B*7g.compensation: After R8h+ the bishop recapture allows Bx3d Bx1a+; taking with the gold instead loses the bishop's useful retreat/promotion sequence and permits stronger rook-drop play.100k Bx8h=+215 versus Gx8h=-865.
B*7g.confidence: Conditional tactical contrast supported at10k and100k; human frequency/salience unmeasured
B*7g.known_or_unknown_motif: rediscovered_known_motif at rook-sacrifice-family level; exact earlier bishop-drop timing unknown_novelty
B*7g.human_review_point: Is taking with gold genuinely tempting compared with bishop? Check the complete earlier bishop-drop timing, not the old17.B7g error.

3d2d.compensation: Tested B6g+ is answered naturally by Gx6g.100k gives+740 for that capture versus-1601 for immediate R2a+. The existence of a worse attacking move does not make the natural recapture difficult. This refutes the tested continuation, not the entire4-five-bishop opening.
3d2d.confidence: Local first-response refutation only. Later counterplay such as R2a+ after R8h+ is not proven easy; no claim that longer multi-stage traps fail. Full100k ranking was not computed.
3d2d.human_review_point: Verify Gx6g and later R2a+ counterplay. P*2c was not proposed by the frozen two-candidate rule; do not insert that known reference afterward.
3d2d.gate_caveat: Frozen10k gate remains not_falsified (reference+274);100k natural defense+740 crosses the provisional defender-advantage boundary. No mixed-budget gate rerun.

3d3f.human_review_point: Compare immediate Gx8h with intermediate B*1e check. Check the normal Bx3f Px3f alternative and do not present the check as a required correct defense.
